subject: Life-Threatening Allergies Policy Revision
overview: The subcommittee met to refine a draft policy on managing life-threatening allergies, focusing on separating high-level policy mandates from detailed operational guidance. The body directed staff to rework the document to improve usability and ensure compliance with collective bargaining agreements.

items.title: Management of Life-Threatening Allergies Policy
items.summary: The subcommittee reviewed a 24-page draft, debating whether to move procedural details and specific roles into separate administrative guidance to allow for easier updates. Discussion focused on practical implementation for athletic team dinners, the elimination of 'allergy tables' to promote inclusion, and restrictions on food-based rewards in classrooms. Approved a motion to have administration and the chair rework the proposal by moving operational sections into a guidance document.
